capabilities: generate index notes listing used links per note
report links to nonexistent files only
count embeds and wiki-links in output
exclude files and paths via regex and glob patterns
create multiple command presets from settings
extras: Author warns they no longer use the plugin themselves, which may signal uncertain future maintenance. README's compatibility section targets Obsidian v0.9.12, a very old version.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to generate vault-wide reports of used links or bulk-detect links pointing to nonexistent files.
summary: Link report generator that creates index notes listing used links, embed counts, and nonexistent targets, configured through multiple presets.
